candidates.name: atopic dermatitis
support_spans: generalized pruritus of 10-years' duration
erythematous papules, some of them crusted, and some excoriations located over the trunk and upper extremities
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms of generalized pruritus and erythematous papules are consistent with atopic dermatitis.

candidates.name: discoid lupus erythematosus
support_spans: scales and fissures were seen on her lower lip, sparing the surrounding skin, as well as inner mouth and upper lip
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms of scales and fissures on the lower lip are consistent with discoid lupus erythematosus.

candidates.name: chronic actinic dermatitis
support_spans: erythema appeared in the area irradiated with UV-A 48 hours afterwards
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms of delayed erythema after UV-A irradiation are consistent with chronic actinic dermatitis.

candidates.name: cutaneous lymphoma
support_spans: a nodular lymphocyte infiltrate in the upper and mid dermis with a peripheral mantle zone surrounding a central germinal center with cells that were CD20 positive and BCL-2 negative
candidates.why: The patient's biopsy results showing a nodular lymphocyte infiltrate are consistent with cutaneous lymphoma.

candidates.name: cutaneous T-cell lymphoma
support_spans: The biopsy results showed spongiosis and erosions in the epidermis and a nodular lymphocyte infiltrate in the upper and mid dermis
candidates.why: The patient's biopsy results would be decisive in confirming cutaneous T-cell lymphoma.

candidates.name: photosensitive lupus erythematosus
support_spans: erythema appeared in the area irradiated with UV-A 48 hours afterwards
candidates.why: The patient's phototest results would be decisive in confirming photosensitive lupus erythematosus.
